1.0.2.en: Improved: power-cut (rejoin) detection on the 3-gang dimmer is faster and no longer misses cuts. Fixed: 4-gang remote buttons could stop responding after an app restart.

1.0.3.en: Improved: devices are now marked unavailable after 5 failed commands or 25 minutes of silence, and come back on the first message. Added a switch in the app settings to turn availability tracking off.
